Grid spec by id, for publish_cog()

Source: R/grid.R
grid_spec_for.Rd

Same plain-list shape grid_spec() returns from a raster, plus grid_id and lon360. When the grid's cell-id COG is on hand its geometry is read from the file (authoritative, and keeps already-published v8 COGs bit-comparable, since the real raster carries ~6e-6 deg of float drift from the nominal values); the registry values are the offline fallback and are asserted against the raster.

Usage

grid_spec_for(grid_id, cellid_tif = NULL)

Arguments

grid_id

one of grid_registry()$grid_id

cellid_tif

optional path to that grid's cell-id COG

Value

a list with nc, nr, xmin, ymax, resx, resy, crs, grid_id, lon360
